notes.title: Welcome, new Scouts!
notes.content:
[h3]If you're new here or you've only just heard of Luna Abyss here's everything you need to know![/h3]

Luna Abyss is a single player story shooter with bullet hell combat. It follows the story of Fawkes - a prisoner of Luna caught between a cryptic prophecy & their prison sentence.

[previewyoutube=PeTUEase0JE;full][/previewyoutube]
[i]Luna Abyss Announcement Trailer[/i]

Scout the depths of the Abyss using biomechanical wardens. Recover forgotten technology from within the Abyss & the lost colony it consumed. Sprint, jump & dash your way through this brutalist megastructure. And face corrupted souls & twisted cosmic horrors in bullet hell combat.

[previewyoutube=M2CLnUZWJds;full][/previewyoutube]
[i]Luna Abyss Gameplay Trailer[/i]

Every move you make will be overseen by your artificial prison guard Aylin. Each mission you complete will reduce your sentence & bring you one step closer to freedom. But these century old ruins are alive with maddening echoes, and the voices of the Abyss call to you...

[previewyoutube=FbF2liWk7bM;full][/previewyoutube]
[i]"Incarcerate" - Luna Abyss Story Trailer[/i]

You can follow along with our development here on Steam & on our community Discord server! [url=https://discord.gg/fvHYFb3w4N]Join Here![/url]

We were also thrilled to announce our partnership with Lost in Cult & Black Screen Records recently to bring the Luna Abyss OST to vinyl! [url=https://www.lostincult.co.uk/lunaabyss]You can register your interest for that by clicking here![/url]

[previewyoutube=ZTRMgryR8gs;full][/previewyoutube]
[i]Luna Abyss at Save & Sound 2023[/i]

notes.title: Save & Sound - A celebration of music in games is going live September 11 - 14!
notes.content:
[h2]Get ready![/h2]

Join us September 11 - 14 right here on Steam for one of the largest digital expos about audio and music in games. Save & Sound features concerts, deep-dives, and mashups from 70+ developers from around the world!

Starting at 10am PDT / 7pm CEST, a 3-day live show from September 11 - 13 will showcase original content made just for Save & Sound. 

Luna Abyss is story shooter with bullet-hell mechanics, and the debut game from creative Unreal Engine studio, Bonsai Collective. The narrative and audio pacing are fundamental to the universe that Bonsai Collective have built, and we're incredibly proud to unveil some of the creative processes that were used to build the soundtrack. Featuring video interviews with Creative Director Benni Hill, Composer David Housden and Senior Writer Laura Mauro, and behind the scenes footage from when we collaborated with the orchestra and choir at Air Lyndhurst Studios London to capture the beautiful celestial essence of Luna Abyss.

[h2]Don’t miss out on updates![/h2]

Set a reminder to be notified when Save & Sound will go live!

The show will be streamed on the Save & Sound website, YouTube, and Twitch. Check out all the games part of the event on [url=saveandsound.io]saveandsound.io[/url]

notes.title: Developing the Weeping Meadows
notes.content:
[h3]The Weeping Meadows[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42816684/3febb2fe2be8c4e9b8bcfb42b1e0d4e76a7b1c6a.png[/img]

This area will probably look familiar to you if you've watched our latest trailers. But it wasn't always like this!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42816684/6eba5669f8d707f9a802ec28ea8ffbdcc56522cd.png[/img]
It started as this concept sketch, which ended up being very different to the in-game level.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42816684/c9b8788cd8c7a4872f1efe4eca3ddb5d95ae5eca.png[/img]
We blocked out the level very roughly to start with as we worked on the level design.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42816684/4c728cc05af417e4082ef4c3dae52f48238cce5a.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42816684/3ee3022f13bb5a32f74e24cc35c47a44ffc485b8.png[/img]
Then, as we were still figuring it out, we used some marketplace assets to populate the level & start to bring it together.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42816684/c3ff6c03ec5d1b7bba2c06982d5ade8aef231090.png[/img]
Once we had a decent idea of the level design, we started creating our own unique assets to replace the placeholders we were using.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42816684/3febb2fe2be8c4e9b8bcfb42b1e0d4e76a7b1c6a.png[/img]
Then we had another art pass over the level to work on anything we felt needed improving, & a few different lighting passes to determine what we wanted the atmosphere to look like.

notes.title: How Sorrow's Canyon Developed Over Time
notes.content:
[h3]The Hydraulic Wall[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42816684/a0967a360e8300e1b053c36cdd3c43a585d0b9b9.png[/img]

For those of you that took part in our recent demo or that have watched our trailers this location will be familiar. But it didn't always look like this...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42816684/6b169b5eccc356d015927fa32531b7081a405d04.png[/img]

Way back when we first started development on Luna Abyss, way back in 2019, this area started out as just a concept sketch.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42816684/baa21134fed3bbc95671c6ab627051b0b4b3c4d3.png[/img]

Then as we started building out the levels it got a very basic starting structure.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42816684/509f673ea12de5ed1528b5066a49fb0edfb26d74.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42816684/cda859f36d34a7dfe3bbd08a57fd18d09077c323.png[/img]

That we built on.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42816684/873775978fdc1a694fa7e08179913383b385a4fd.png[/img]

And built on.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42816684/a0967a360e8300e1b053c36cdd3c43a585d0b9b9.png[/img]

Until we get to the version that you see today. Personally, I think our art team did a fantastic job. What do you think?

notes.title: Greetings, scouts!
notes.content:
[h2]I've been warning you that the Abyss was a dangerous place, but some of you still don't believe me... Let's take a quick look at some more of our enemies![/h2]

[h3]The Death Candle[/h3]

Once affectionately referred to as 'Floaties', a passing flock was considered a portent of good fortune. These days they're more likely to explode in your face. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42816684/588fc7d48d6a8b2456825ff09ac9c973da1a62c4.png[/img]


[h3]The Celebrant[/h3]

Celebrants retain an uncommon awareness, which makes them especially dangerous. Use every tool in your arsenal - including stopping to hide when things get intense.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42816684/e149517ba3e16b6f82dc4cea030aa7ff90b1daac.png[/img]


[h3]The Eye of Virtue[/h3]

They are known to appear in packs, perhaps compensating for their lack of mobility. But don't take them lightly: their precision across long distances is second to none. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42816684/8c8c03737bc7ff2dfd35266c049fc587b73ae23b.png[/img]


Until next time, stay safe out there...

notes.title: Greetings, scouts!
notes.content:
[h2]We did warn you that the Abyss could be dangerous... Let's take a quick look at some of the enemies we've seen so far! [/h2]


[h3]The Rawhed[/h3]

The Rawheds are the most numerous of the Adrift with a tendency to swarm. Stay alert & make sure they don't outnumber you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42816684/dac75cf024560845928b27d104235a4b0c4f2434.png[/img]

[h3]The Mother-Eyes[/h3]

Nobody knows who "Mother" is, but you better be careful around the Mother-Eyes Network. They'll alert one another to your presence & call in reinforcements. Be prepared to fight at all times.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42816684/d6b56f4af823b8361c13c304398576e91ae976cd.png[/img]

[h3]The Bloodybones[/h3]

It's common knowledge among scouts that where there's one Bloodybones, more are likely to follow. Other Adrift seem to follow them in the Abyss... maybe they're at the top of a hierarchy we don't know of?

notes.title: Welcome to the Abyss
notes.content:
[h1]Welcome to the Abyss![/h1]

[i]Due to your… unfortunate circumstances you have been incarcerated here on the mimic moon of Luna. There’s no need to worry, we’ll make sure you’re comfortable enough. The work will be hard, and it will likely be dangerous, after all… the Abyss has been known to attract… undesirable things. [/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42816684/712fac817a159071fc6bad41a542d61e406edcdc.jpg[/img]

I need you to take control of my remote wardens and scout the depths of the Abyss; a colossal mega-structure deep below the surface of this alien moon. There’s plenty to see and do down there, technology to scavenge, secrets to find. Besides, it’s not like you really have a choice in the matter... think of this as your home away from home.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42816684/6a042b3c8c9cd1715b1fbde9f927d9c9c66b5cba.jpg[/img]

But be careful inmate… danger is the name of the game in the Abyss and it’s rather unavoidable. A stray bullet here, a creeping monster there. Just you do your best and try not to die. It would be awfully inconvenient for me to lose a new scout.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42816684/6f0b58dbe24436faa97c7e92f258617cadf2789c.jpg[/img]

Oh! And my name is Aylin. My job is to take care of our prison populace… so I’ll be keeping my eye on you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42816684/bff69d0a4625515465406b8641e263fb2ddbf0d7.jpg[/img]
